title: Gemma 4 31B as a base (--base gemma-4-31b): google/gemma-4-31B-it quantized to FP8 on load, every gate measure, on one card in one session
hardware: 1x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition (97,887 MiB, driver 610.43.02), a container on a rented GPU host

software.checkpoint: google/gemma-4-31B-it at revision 842da3794eaa0b77d5f08bae87a17459d91ff475, official, quantized to FP8 by vLLM when it loads (quantization="fp8")
software.decisio: 249b56d (branch gemma4-mm-bases: the plugin pair DecisioGemma4TextOnly and DecisioGemma4HiddenReadout, and the base's prompt as this record's profile), with the temperature served at 1 and fitted offline
software.server: --base gemma-4-31b --debug-readout, with --engine '{"quantization": "fp8"}' at the time; the profile now carries FP8 on load

harnesses.jevbench: published items, 231, bundle bb05a33; the v1.5 open-set reading by decisio.bench.jevbench_v15
harnesses.decision_index: 0.2.1 rows for BANKING77, CLINC150+OOS, GPQA Diamond and MMLU-Pro (decisio.bench.di_rows)

temperatures.interval: T in [0.2, 50], 5-fold cross-validation stratified by task

results.memory_fp8: weights 30.61 GiB, KV cache 48.6 GiB (57,882 tokens) at the 0.90 share
results.memory_bf16: did not start at a 32,768-token context: 20.24 GiB left for the KV cache, 27.51 GiB needed, 24,096 tokens the most that fits (bf16_start.txt)

deviations: the session's pre-registered rule did not pass the 31B (BANKING77, CLINC150+OOS and MMLU-Pro below the thresholds, the board's Decider chat Gemma-4-31B row, by 0.2 to 1.1 points); the maintainer's decision made it a base, with the reason stated in EVAL_CARD.md section 7
the pre-registered precision was bf16; the 31B does not start at bf16 at a 32,768-token context on this card, so the session measured it in FP8 on load under a dated amendment written before the run
the temperature search interval was widened from [0.2, 5] to [0.2, 50] after the first FP8 fit landed on 5.0; the fit is interior
excluded: the Decision Index per-item results (request ids, payload sha256 and responses are in the private record)
server logs (vLLM's memory lines are in memory_*.txt and bf16_start.txt)
